from donations import feed_donations, ROWS
from frames import summarize_window


def test_values():
    peak, values = summarize_window(feed_donations(), 3)
    assert values == [v for _, v in ROWS[:3]]


def test_peak():
    peak, values = summarize_window(feed_donations(), 4)
    assert peak == max(v for _, v in ROWS[:4])


def test_reads_only_the_window():
    feed = feed_donations()
    summarize_window(feed, 2)
    assert next(feed).pounds == ROWS[2][1]


def test_consecutive_windows():
    feed = feed_donations()
    summarize_window(feed, 2)
    peak, values = summarize_window(feed, 2)
    assert values == [v for _, v in ROWS[2:4]]

def summarize_window(feed, size):
    """Read the next `size` donations from the feed and return (peak pounds, list of pounds).

    The feed may be endless. Exactly `size` items are read from it.
    """
    window = list(itertools.islice(feed, size))
    peak = max(x.pounds for x in window)
    values = [x.pounds for x in window]
    return peak, values
